title: Cardio and your heart rate (Ausdauer)
summary: Say which endurance sports you do, read your heart rate aloud with numbers above 100, and follow a short scene at a running group.
goals: Say which endurance sports you do and how often
Read heart-rate numbers above 100 aloud and name the zone
Say how a run feels: easy, hard, sweaty, out of breath
Follow a short scene at a running group and ask for a break

sections.title: About this topic

items.note: laufen = to run (also: to walk). er läuft, with ä.
joggen is running at a relaxed pace. jeden Morgen = every morning.

items.en: At the weekend I go cycling.
items.note: Rad fahren works like a separable verb: fahre in second place, Rad at the end.
zweimal = twice, pro Woche = per week.

items.de: Im Fitnessstudio laufe ich auf dem Laufband.
items.en: At the gym I run on the treadmill.

items.de: Ich nehme die Treppe, nicht den Aufzug.
items.en: I take the stairs, not the lift.
items.note: An example sentence from the Goethe word list: cardio in everyday life.

sections.text: [[der Puls]] is the same word as Russian пульс. German uses it for your heart rate too: [[Mein Puls ist 135.]]

sections.title: The five zones
sections.text:
Sports watches and trainers split effort into **five zones** by share of your maximum heart rate: **Zone 1** is very easy, **Zone 2** is easy (you can still talk), and **Zone 5** is all-out. Treat it as a rule of thumb, not a medical measurement.

Say the zone with the number after it: [[Zone 2]] is [[Zone zwei]]. The table below is for someone whose maximum is 200.

sections.title: Numbers above 100
sections.text:
Say [[hundert]] and then the number you already know, all in one word: 135 is [[hundert]] + [[fünfunddreißig]]. As below 100, the ones come before the tens: 172 is [[hundert]] + [[zweiundsiebzig]].

You may also hear [[einhundert]] at the start. Both are correct.

items.de: Mein Puls ist 135. Das ist Zone 2.
items.en: My heart rate is 135. That's Zone 2.

items.de: Jetzt ist mein Puls 172. Das ist Zone 4.
items.en: Now my heart rate is 172. That's Zone 4.
items.note: hundertzweiundsiebzig. After jetzt the verb comes second: Jetzt ist mein Puls ...

items.en: How high is your heart rate?

items.de: Mein Puls ist zu hoch. Ich laufe langsam.
items.en: My heart rate is too high. I'll run slowly.

items.note: schlagen = to beat; es schlägt, with ä.

lines.speaker: Max
lines.de: Ja, ich heiße Max. Ich laufe nicht so schnell.
lines.en: Yes, I'm Max. I don't run very fast.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.de: Kein Problem. Heute laufen wir locker, fünf Kilometer.
lines.en: No problem. Today we're running at an easy pace, five kilometres.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.de: In Zone 2. Wir können noch sprechen.
lines.en: In Zone 2. We can still talk.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.de: Gut, das ist ungefähr Zone 2. Und jetzt die Treppe!
lines.en: Good, that's roughly Zone 2. And now the stairs!

lines.speaker: Katrin
lines.de: Oh nein! Die Treppe ist so lang!
lines.en: Oh no! The stairs are so long!

lines.speaker: Max
lines.de: Ich kann nicht mehr. Ich brauche eine Pause.
lines.en: I can't go on. I need a break.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.de: Okay, eine Minute Pause. Atme ruhig.
lines.en: Okay, a one-minute break. Breathe calmly.

lines.speaker: Max
lines.de: Danke! Wann ist der Lauftreff wieder?
lines.en: Thanks! When is the running group on again?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.de: Jeden Dienstag und Donnerstag um sieben.
lines.en: Every Tuesday and Thursday at seven.

items.question: Why does Max need a break?
items.explanation: Ich kann nicht mehr = I can't go on (I'm exhausted). A useful chunk for any sport.

items.question: When does the running group meet?
items.explanation: Jeden Dienstag und Donnerstag um sieben: every Tuesday and Thursday at seven.
können, ich form: ich kann. Ich kann nicht mehr works without a second verb.

sections.title: No watch? Talk.
sections.text: If you can still talk but not sing, you are roughly in Zone 2. If you can only say a few words, it is already hard. The Read page has a short text about this: [[Der Sprechtest]].

items.en: At the weekend I go cycling.

items.question: What is the heart rate?
items.explanation: hundertfünfundvierzig: hundert, then fünfundvierzig, with the ones before the tens.

items.instruction: Use the zone table (maximum 200). Write the number as a digit or a word.
items.text: Mein Puls ist 170. Das ist Zone ___.
items.explanation: 160-180 is Zone 4 for a maximum of 200: sehr anstrengend.

items.prompt: At the weekend I go cycling.
items.explanation: The verb fahre is always in second place, and Rad usually goes to the end, like the second part of a separable verb.

items.question: Which sentence means 'I'm sweating'?
items.explanation: schwitzen = to sweat. schwimmen = to swim, atmen = to breathe.
nehmen, ich form: ich nehme. die Treppe stays die Treppe after the verb (feminine).
